description: React component for a feature restriction modal in Mattermost, handling UI logic for licensing, trial, and admin notifications.

classes.name: FeatureRestrictedModal
classes.description: React functional component for displaying a modal that restricts features based on licensing and user permissions.

methods.name: dismissAction
methods.description: Closes the modal by dispatching closeModal action.

methods.name: handleViewPlansClick
methods.description: Handles click event for viewing plans or notifying admin based on user role and environment.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Determines modal title based on user role and trial status.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Determines modal message content based on user role and trial status.
